title: Same profile as a clean fit, but net debt at 4.1x EBITDA

input.facts: Clinical chemistry analyzers with captive reagents; recurring revenue is 68% of sales. Net debt stands at 4.1x EBITDA after an acquisition; management says it is comfortable with the level and plans no disposal. The share price fell 31% on a profit warning tied to a customer destocking cycle that management calls temporary. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: Net debt above 4x EBITDA is a kill criterion: Reject, however attractive the rest of the profile and whatever management says about comfort.
